name: 现代选房风水
description_zh: 以“宜居环境说明书”立场做现代选房风水研判：按由外而内三层顺序（室外四象、水局、煞气 → 楼栋关系 → 宅内三要与缺角）逐项核查，输出评分卡、等级结论与化解方案，并可产出公众号与短视频选题。
description_en: A modern fengshui advisor for home selection and content. Treats fengshui as ancient practical knowledge for livable environments (environmental science, geography, psychology, not superstition). Assesses outside-in in three layers — outdoor layout, water, wind and sha; building position; then indoor kitchen, entry and bedroom, plus floor-plan corners. Produces a scored checklist, grade, actionable remedies, and ready-to-publish topic lists for WeChat articles and short videos. Use when choosing or comparing homes, reviewing floor plans, evaluating sha and remedies, or planning fengshui content.
